content: AdMob UMP correct order: requestConsentInfoUpdate -> loadAndShowConsentFormIfRequired -> check canRequestAds (in BOTH success and error path) -> MobileAds.initialize() -> load rewarded. canRequestAds() false until requestConsentInfoUpdate called; consentStatus OBTAINED does NOT mean consented (decline => canRequestAds false). Skipping error-path check silently yields zero ad fills. Call consent flow every launch (form only shows when required).
